text:
devrel-aiko: Quick announce — launching the Maintainer Mentor Pilot v0.0.1 :sparkles: repo + pairing program to help first-time contributors get a 1:1 mentor for their first PR. Release: https://github.com/redwood/maintainer-mentor/releases/tag/v0.0.1
devrel-aiko: What it includes: mentor pairing flow, onboarding checklist, and a sandbox runner for guided pair-programming. goal is to reduce time-to-first-merge from days -> hours.
ci-bot: CI: Published release artifacts and tag `v0.0.1` for redwood/maintainer-mentor — checks passed 
mentorship-sam: love it. added a small mentor guide under docs/mentor-guide.md (tips for productive 30-min sessions).
pm-ravi: can we include an opt-in availability calendar for mentors (so maintainers can pick times)? will coordinate with community team.
community-lina: i'll draft a short community post and recruit volunteer mentors. also scheduling a pilot cohort next Tue 6pm PT.
devrel-aiko: Office hours + live demo tomorrow 11am PT in #devrel-qa — will show pairing flow and how to enable the sandbox. bring a laptop if you want to test as a mentee.
mentorship-sam: added a quick token-safety note to README about using scoped test tokens in the sandbox.
devrel-aiko: thanks all! we'll track feedback in repo issues labeled `mentor-pilot` — please file tiny PRs for docs nits. :rocket:
